title: Cabcharge Australia Ltd - proposed acquisition of Arrow Taxi Services Ltd

body_sections.Summary: Cabcharge Australia Ltd (Cabcharge) principally supplies the Cabcharge account facility for the payment of taxi fares. In Melbourne, Cabcharge also owns Black Cabs Combined (BCC) which, among other things, operates a taxi depot for its members, who operate in the Melbourne metropolitan taxi-cab zone (as defined by government regulation). BCC also supplies automated taxi booking and dispatch network services. Arrow Taxi Services Ltd (Arrow) operates a taxi depot and provides administrative services to its members, who also operate principally in the Melbourne metropolitan zone. Arrow currently outsources its taxi booking and dispatch services to BCC.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the impact of the proposed acquisition on the markets for: - the provision of taxi depot services to taxi operators in the Melbourne metropolitan taxi-cab zone; and - the provision of taxi services to the public in the Melbourne metropolitan taxi-cab zone.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC concluded that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in either market given that it involves only a small increase in market concentration. Accordingly, the ACCC decided not to intervene.
